Aside from physical entities such as people, New Order was able to affect incorporeal things such as the air, laser beams, and even affect other Quirks ((This does NOT mean she can use another quirk as her OWN, for example she can NOT use OFA because she doesn’t have it)).

(Weakness)- The effects granted by New Order were not omnipotent, as there were limits to how great they became. There was also a hard limit on how strong Cathleen could make herself with her Quirk, and she could not use it to become all-powerful or invincible. However the only exception is that if it causes death and the person dies then they will stay dead). Furthermore, a rule could not arbitrarily affect another target she had not touched through clever wording (i.e. after she touches the air, and calling out New Order: making it so that someone who also touches the air will die).
